mdcw_gw_ministry_list_partners = {

 # IMPERIA CW — Cold War: reopening a tab reuses a seven-day country-local register.
 # Real contract eligibility and every physical transfer remain live-validated.
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = gw_ui_partner_register_current } }
  clear_array = gw_ui_candidates
  every_country = {
   limit = { exists = yes has_idea = mdcw_ni_overseas_employment_programme NOT = { tag = ROOT } }
   ROOT = { add_to_array = { gw_ui_candidates = PREV.id } }
  }
  set_country_flag = { flag = gw_ui_partner_register_current days = 7 }
  set_variable = { gw_ui_partner_page = 0 }
 }
 mdcw_gw_ministry_partner_page = yes

}

mdcw_gw_ministry_refresh_partners = {

 # IMPERIA CW — Cold War: one explicit extra update per game day prevents click spam.
 if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = gw_ui_partner_report_requested } }
  set_country_flag = { flag = gw_ui_partner_report_requested days = 1 }
  clr_country_flag = gw_ui_partner_register_current
  mdcw_gw_ministry_list_partners = yes
 }

}

  set_variable = { gw_host1_origin = gw_hosts^gw_ui_host_i }
  var:gw_host1_origin = {
   if = { limit = { exists = yes }
    set_temp_variable = { gw_lookup_origin = ROOT.id } mdcw_gw_find_origin = yes
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_index > -1 } }
     ROOT = { set_variable = { gw_host1_k = PREV.gw_stock^PREV.gw_index } }
    }
   }
  }

mdcw_gw_ministry_host_selection = {
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_stock_k = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_registered_k = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_housed_k = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_protected_k = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_return_rate = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_return_last = 0 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_return_expected = 0 }
 if = { limit = { has_variable = gw_ui_host check_variable = { gw_ui_host > -1 } }
  var:gw_ui_host = {
   if = { limit = { exists = yes }
    set_temp_variable = { gw_lookup_origin = ROOT.id } mdcw_gw_find_origin = yes
    if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_index > -1 } }
     set_temp_variable = { gw_mi = gw_index }
     set_temp_variable = { gw_mo = ROOT.id }
     mdcw_dp_return_rate = yes
     ROOT = {
      set_variable = { gw_ui_host_stock_k = PREV.gw_stock^PREV.gw_index }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_host_registered_k = PREV.gw_registered^PREV.gw_index }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_host_housed_k = PREV.gw_housed^PREV.gw_index }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_host_protected_k = PREV.gw_protected^PREV.gw_index }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_return_rate = PREV.gw_rate }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_return_last = PREV.gw_return_last^PREV.gw_index }
      set_variable = { gw_ui_return_expected = PREV.gw_return_basis^PREV.gw_index }
      multiply_variable = { gw_ui_return_expected = gw_ui_return_rate }
      divide_variable = { gw_ui_return_expected = 100 }
     }
    }
   }
  }
 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_people = gw_ui_host_stock_k }
 clamp_variable = { var = gw_ui_host_people min = 0 max = 2000 } multiply_variable = { gw_ui_host_people = 1000 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_host_m = gw_ui_host_stock_k } divide_variable = { gw_ui_host_m = 1000 }

 set_variable = { gw_ui_registered_ratio = 0 }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_ui_host_stock_k > 0 } }
  set_variable = { gw_ui_registered_ratio = gw_ui_host_registered_k }
  divide_variable = { gw_ui_registered_ratio = gw_ui_host_stock_k }
 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_registered_frame = gw_ui_registered_ratio } multiply_variable = { gw_ui_registered_frame = 10 }
 round_variable = gw_ui_registered_frame add_to_variable = { gw_ui_registered_frame = 1 }

 set_variable = { gw_ui_housed_ratio = 0 }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_ui_host_stock_k > 0 } }
  set_variable = { gw_ui_housed_ratio = gw_ui_host_housed_k }
  divide_variable = { gw_ui_housed_ratio = gw_ui_host_stock_k }
 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_housed_frame = gw_ui_housed_ratio } multiply_variable = { gw_ui_housed_frame = 10 }
 round_variable = gw_ui_housed_frame add_to_variable = { gw_ui_housed_frame = 1 }

 set_variable = { gw_ui_protected_ratio = 0 }
 if = { limit = { check_variable = { gw_ui_host_stock_k > 0 } }
  set_variable = { gw_ui_protected_ratio = gw_ui_host_protected_k }
  divide_variable = { gw_ui_protected_ratio = gw_ui_host_stock_k }
 }
 set_variable = { gw_ui_protected_frame = gw_ui_protected_ratio } multiply_variable = { gw_ui_protected_frame = 10 }
 round_variable = gw_ui_protected_frame add_to_variable = { gw_ui_protected_frame = 1 }

 add_to_variable = { gw_ui_dirty = 1 }
}

# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: outreach uses the same native prices and eligibility as the existing decision.
mdcw_gw_ministry_confirm_outreach = {
 if = { limit = {
  has_country_flag = gw_dialog_valid has_country_flag = gw_dialog_window
  NOT = { check_variable = { political_power < 75 } } NOT = { check_variable = { treasury < 0.5 } }
  var:gw_dialog_host = { mdcw_gw_outreach_target_valid = yes }
 }
  add_political_power = -75 subtract_from_variable = { treasury = 0.5 }
  var:gw_dialog_host = {
   set_temp_variable = { gw_lookup_origin = ROOT.id } mdcw_gw_find_origin = yes
   set_variable = { gw_outreach^gw_index = 1 }
   add_to_variable = { gw_ui_dirty = 1 }
   country_event = { id = mdcw_diaspora.80 days = 180 }
  }
  ingame_update_setup = yes
 }
 clr_country_flag = gw_dialog_valid clr_country_flag = gw_dialog_window
}
